rule: A gap records missing or unresolved authority/implementation. It does not authorize EPV3 to fill the gap.

gaps.name: SECOND_PEER_PRIOR_INPUT_CONTRACT
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Accepted current V3 input type/port and binding contract at the exact R03 base.
negative_authority: Do not route PSEPF through V558 structural semantics.
Do not insert PSEPF geometry directly into stored actor state.
Do not copy PSEPF geometry into the V3 envelope.

gaps.name: METABOLISM_AUTHORITY
gaps.present_authority: R02 names V3_EMPIRICAL_POSSIBILITY_METABOLISM_AUTHORITY as a required envelope binding.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Exact rule identity/version/hash, admissible V3 consumers, allowed operations, result states and semantic ceiling.
gaps.required_noncollapse: Population possibility constrains only where a V3 owner explicitly admits its use; it never directly becomes actor state.
negative_authority: No belief_probability = field.mass.
No modal-cell response assignment.
No identity/persona assignment.
No memory/knowledge creation from field geometry.

gaps.name: OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_FACT_SNAPSHOT_BINDING
gaps.present_authority: ADP-007/009/015 and neighboring V3 owners create actor-specific objective facts; R02 requires an objective-fact snapshot/ref set for comparator production.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Exact eligible objective fact classes, snapshot/currentness identity, effective-time semantics and comparator-facing projection contract.
gaps.required_noncollapse: Generated actor fact != survey coordinate != PSEPF conditioner label.
negative_authority: No prevalence or shared label may manufacture a generated fact.
Missing objective facts may not be filled from population averages.

gaps.name: PSEPF_LIFECYCLE_STALENESS_REFRESH
gaps.present_authority: R02 requires current/stale/refresh-required/invalidated/unavailable; CAN-007 is a separate structural-context lifecycle precedent.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Exact PSEPF V3-side staleness predicate, refresh owner, trigger set, dedup/coalescence, stale-use rejection and requery receipt.
gaps.required_noncollapse: Field object immutability != perpetual V3 admissibility; refresh != causal event; refresh != field mutation.
negative_authority: No hidden latest.
No polling/annual default cadence.
No reuse after actor snapshot/use/effective-time authority is stale.

gaps.name: PSEPF_EFFECTIVE_TIME_ALIGNMENT
gaps.present_authority: R02 distinguishes actor-fact effective time, PSEPF source/historical time and V3 decision/effective time; ADP-021 owns V3 scheduler time coordination.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Exact authorized alignment rule and fail-closed noncomparability behavior for a given V3 use class.
gaps.required_noncollapse: Source time != actor fact time != decision time.
negative_authority: No silent nearest-time alignment.
No backdating future evidence into lived history.

gaps.name: PSEPF_TYPED_NEGATIVE_ADMISSION
gaps.present_authority: R02 enumerates typed negative/availability states; existing V3 authorities preserve distinct negative/valid-empty/missing/deferred/integrity classes.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Exact intake receipt/result and transition-side handling for each state.
gaps.required_noncollapse: NO_COMPARATOR != AMBIGUOUS_COMPARATOR != ZERO_SUPPORT != LOW_SUPPORT != TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE != missing metabolism authority.
negative_authority: No nearest cohort.
No default belief.
No null-to-zero coercion.
No low-support-to-certainty promotion.

gaps.name: PSEPF_REPLAY_CAUSAL_PROVENANCE
gaps.present_authority: V3 event/replay authorities require exact content/provenance-bound identity; R02 requires replay/intake receipt and transitive comparator/query/source provenance.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Exact V3 intake receipt schema and causal-parent/reference rule for a transition that actually consulted a field.
gaps.required_noncollapse: ReplayReceipt is audit/replay evidence, not developmental prior; ActorComparatorReceipt is provenance-only in V3.
negative_authority: No receipt object may substitute for field semantics.
No mutable/latest provenance reference.
No unrecorded prior version in causal replay.

gaps.name: TRANSITION_READ_PERMISSION_MATRIX
gaps.present_authority: Existing ADP/CAN authorities separately own actor mutations.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Which exact transition families can read which PSEPF use classes and whether use is prerequisite, constraint, candidate-weighting input, diagnostic-only or denied.
gaps.required_noncollapse: Scheduler invokes owners; prior intake does not create universal cross-domain read permission.
negative_authority: No global all-transitions-can-read-PSEPF flag.
No field-driven mutation outside the owning transition authority.

gaps.name: DIVERGENCE_REPLAY_HARNESS
gaps.present_authority: R03E requires same PSEPF + same ResolvedStructuralContext to permit divergent lawful lives; V3 owns history/event/path dependence.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Production hostile fixtures demonstrating identical upstream priors do not collapse V3 trajectories and that replay remains deterministic for each exact causal history/RNG receipt set.
negative_authority: No deterministic persona/profile assignment from priors.
No hidden RNG outside ADP-020.

gaps.name: CURRENT_PRODUCTION_V3_RUNTIME
gaps.present_authority: Accepted V3 authority architecture and W3 bounded fixture packet program.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Canonical current top-level production V3/V2 implementation corresponding to the accepted authority contracts at this exact base.
gaps.required_noncollapse: Architecture acceptance != production implementation; fixture implementation != complete runtime release.
negative_authority: Do not promote historical recovered v3/v2/server code to current authority.
Do not treat superseded V558 runtime-graft modules as ResolvedStructuralContext implementation.

gaps.name: V2_DIRECT_PSEPF_NONCONSUMPTION_ENFORCEMENT
gaps.classification: negative authority present; PSEPF-specific implementation test missing
gaps.present_authority: V2 law denies direct V558 behavioral/persona authority and limits V2 to actor-safe V3 truth; R03 explicitly attacks direct PSEPF personalization.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: PSEPF-specific typed/schema/prompt hostile harness in the eventual production V2/app boundary.
negative_authority: No raw PSEPF prompt field.
No comparator label as persona trait.
No source disagreement as direct style/voice instruction.

gaps.name: V2_PSEPF_PROVENANCE_VISIBILITY
gaps.present_authority: V2 may receive opaque provenance refs through V3 for audit but may not dereference upstream priors behaviorally.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Whether any future application/audit consumer actually requires a PSEPF provenance ref and, if so, the V3-owned opaque envelope that prevents semantic dereference.
gaps.required_noncollapse: opaque provenance != actor-accessible truth != prompt authority
negative_authority: Do not add PSEPF fields to V2/app merely because the upstream lane exists.
Do not expose geometry/support/rank to the renderer as behavioral evidence.

gaps.name: PSEPF_SOURCE_UNIVERSE_AND_USE_SCOPE_BINDING
gaps.classification: upstream identity must be preserved; V3 binding unresolved
gaps.present_authority: Corrected upstream law preserves source universes by default; R02 requires exact source-indexed PSEPF refs and V3 use class.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Exact V3-side admissibility rule for multiple source-indexed fields, disagreement and noncomparability without silent pooling.
gaps.required_noncollapse: multiple lawful population priors != one averaged actor prior
negative_authority: No silent source pooling.
No source disagreement -> actor contradiction without developmental authority.
No higher-support source automatically becomes actor truth.

gaps.name: PSEPF_TO_MEMORY_KNOWLEDGE_ACTION_FIREWALL
gaps.classification: negative authority strong; dedicated integration proof missing
gaps.present_authority: ADP-016 and ADP-017 require exact V3 causal parents/effects; V2 external interaction requires ADP-019 admission.
gaps.missing_or_unresolved: Integrated hostile tests proving PSEPF cannot directly create memory, knowledge, belief, relationship truth, action occurrence or first-person claim permission.
negative_authority: PSEPF cannot be a GeneratedMemoryState source event.
PSEPF cannot be an ActorEpistemicEffect.
PSEPF cannot make a V2 candidate utterance causal.
